target.title: fix(github-copilot): add timeout to embedding model discovery
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`discoverEmbeddingModels` in the GitHub Copilot embedding provider calls `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without a `timeoutMs`. A hanging `/models` endpoint can leave the embedding provider adapter stalled during setup, the same class of issue fixed in #102050 (Google Vertex ADC token refresh timeout).

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a 30s timeout to the Copilot embedding model discovery request so that provider setup fails fast instead of hanging indefinitely when GitHub Copilot's `/models` endpoint stops responding.

## User Impact

Creating the GitHub Copilot embedding provider will time out instead of hanging forever if the model discovery endpoint is unresponsive.

## Evidence

### Unit tests

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/github-copilot/embeddings.test.ts
```

Result: `Tests 13 passed (1)`.

The new test asserts that the discovery request is forwarded to `fetchWithSsrFGuard` with `timeoutMs: 30_000`.

### SDK-level real behavior proof

`fetchWithSsrFGuard` honors the `timeoutMs` option. A loopback server that accepts the TCP connection but never sends a byte causes the guarded fetch to reject within the configured timeout:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/github-copilot/embeddings.timeout-loopback.test.ts
```

(The temporary test file was removed before commit; the command output below is preserved as proof.)

## Real behavior proof

- **Command run:** `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/github-copilot/embeddings.timeout-loopback.test.ts`
- **Exact output:** `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 1 passed (1) / Duration ~1.3s`
- **Head SHA:** `79ee01eec72428a72ea3f01fa0caa1bf8e881cca`
- **Environment:** Linux, Node 22.19, local checkout
- **Observed result:** The guarded fetch against the hanging loopback server rejected within `timeoutMs + 2s` and after `timeoutMs - 100ms` with `timeoutMs: 500`.
- **What was not tested:** Live GitHub Copilot `/models` endpoint (no live token).
